instructions: StudioTwin generates production assets (environment maps, PBR materials, 3D meshes, character motion, sound effects) for Unreal Engine, Blender and 3D web projects. Workflow: (1) optionally call studiotwin_estimate_cost, (2) call a generation tool — it returns a job uuid immediately, (3) poll studiotwin_get_job_status until COMPLETE, (4) download outputs via the returned URLs, or pass asset references to in-engine StudioTwin integrations (UE / Blender MCP toolsets) which can import by asset id. Use studiotwin_upload_asset to create a presigned upload session, upload files to S3, then call studiotwin_complete_asset_upload to add them to the asset library. Use studiotwin_list_my_assets to browse, studiotwin_resolve_asset for a presigned download URL, and studiotwin_cancel_job to cancel a queued/submitted job you own. Use studiotwin_conceptlab_* tools to create and manage durable ConceptLab creative iterations; poll studiotwin_conceptlab_get_status after ConceptLab image operations. Generations cost credits; failures with code 40001 mean the wallet balance is too low.

autoScale.description: Whether to automatically scale the model to real-world dimensions in meters.

compression.description: Output compression. 'none' omits Tripo's compress option; 'geometry' enables Meshopt geometry compression for GLB triangle output.

enableImageAutofix.description: Whether to optimize the input image for better generation results (takes longer). Default: false.

exportOrientation.description: Optional forward axis for the exported model. Leave unset when later Tripo post-processing is planned.

exportUv.description: Whether to perform UV unwrapping during generation. Disabling it speeds up generation and reduces mesh size. Default: true.

faceLimit.description: Maximum face count. P1 supports 50–20,000; P2 supports 48–50,000 for triangles or 48–25,000 for quads; v3.1 supports up to 2,000,000.

generateParts.description: Output segmented 3D models where each part is individually editable. v3.1 only. Requires texture=false and pbr=false. +20 credits. Incompatible with quad=true.

geometryQuality.description: Geometry detail level. 'detailed' produces maximum-detail meshes for intricate models. 'standard' is balanced. v3.1 only. +20 credits.

maxPollTimeMs.description: Maximum time to wait for generation to complete (milliseconds). Default: 900000 (15 minutes).

modelVersion.description: Tripo3D model version. P2 is the next-generation P Series preview with quad output.

needPbr.description: Whether to generate PBR textures (basecolor, normal, roughness, metalness) embedded in the output model.

needQuadMesh.description: Whether to output a quad-dominant mesh vs. a triangle mesh. Supported by P2 and v3.1.

orientation.description: Auto-rotate the model to align with the original image. 'align_image' enables this and only affects textured output.

referenceImage.description: Input image (photograph, render, or illustration) provided as a StudioTwin asset reference (vpc::assets/<uuid>) or Base64 data URI. Supported formats: PNG, JPG/JPEG, and WEBP; maximum 20 MB.

seed.description: Random seed (0–2³¹−1) for reproducible geometry generation. Omit for a random result.

smartLowPoly.description: Generate low-poly meshes with hand-crafted topology. Best for simple inputs. May fail on complex models. v3.1 only. +10 credits.

texture.description: Whether to generate texture maps for the model. When false, the result is bare geometry. Default: true.

textureAlignment.description: Prioritization of texture alignment in the 3D model. 'original_image' (default) favors visual fidelity; 'geometry' favors 3D structural accuracy.

textureQuality.description: Texture quality for PBR maps. 'extreme' requests Tripo's highest-fidelity 8K textures.

mesh.description: S3 presigned URL for the generated 3D mesh file (GLB for triangle output or FBX when quad=true, 1-hour expiry). Prefers the PBR-textured variant if available, otherwise the base model.

Must be divisible by 16, ≤3840, and combine with 'height' to satisfy OpenAI's resolution constraints (pixels between 655,360 and 8,294,400, aspect ratio ≤3:1). If the resolved (width,height) is not in the preset list, the tool snaps to the nearest preset (tie → smaller).

imageUrls.description: Array of S3 URIs, one per variant. Returned when n>1.

sizeSnapped.description: True if the tool changed the resolution client-side (caller asked for a size not in the preset list).

sourceAsset.description: Input source asset S3 URI, propagated unchanged when supplied.

usage.description: OpenAI token usage pass-through: { input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, input_tokens_details: { image_tokens, text_tokens }, output_tokens_details: { image_tokens, text_tokens } }.

tools.description: Create an upload session for the authenticated user's asset library. Returns an S3 presigned POST with a url and required form fields. tools.description: Close a StudioTwin asset upload session after its presigned S3 POST uploads finish. Creates asset records for the uploaded files and returns their asset uuids for use as generation inputs.

tools.description: Queue one billable image on an idle draft Concept. Defaults to medium quality at 1024x1024 (about 6 credits); an owned source image adds 2 credits. Cost varies with quality and resolution (about 1–74 credits). The persisted conceptType is used. Poll studiotwin_conceptlab_get_status.

modelId.description: Image model. Currently only openai/gpt-image-2 is supported.

user.description: Required image-generation or edit instruction, including when a source image is used.

params.description: Optional model-specific generation parameters. conceptType is derived from the Concept and cannot be overridden here.

quality.description: Output quality; defaults to medium. Higher quality generally costs more credits.

resolution.description: Output resolution; defaults to 1024x1024 and affects cost. auto lets the provider choose and is estimated as 1024x1024. Prefer square for object, portrait for character, and landscape for environmentMap or world Concepts.
